passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.description: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Arcanopulse
spells.description: Begin Charging: Xerath begins charging an arcane beam, Slowing himself gradually up to 50%. Release: Xerath fires the beam, dealing magic damage. The range increases with time charged.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TooltipTotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Eye of Destruction
spells.description: Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing magic damage and Slowing them by % for seconds. Enemies in the center take magic damage instead and are Slowed by %, decaying over seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Shocking Orb
spells.description: Xerath fires an orb of raw magic, Stunning the first enemy hit for up to seconds based on distance travelled, and dealing magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TooltipTotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Rite of the Arcane
spells.description: Xerath ascends to his true form and channels for seconds. During this time he may Recast up to times. Recast: Xerath launches a magical artillery, dealing magic damage. For each champion hit, the artillery deals an additional magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TooltipTotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
